newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 16.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 16.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had one large one day net miss on Monday, causing there to be more reserves in the banking system because tresury deposits at the Federal Bank were much lower than anticipated, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The high in natural float was about $1.4 billion on Monday, while the low was a bit under $1.2 billion on Thursday.
Transportation float averaged at about $200 million per day, with the high on Friday at about a bit over $300 million primarily due to de-icing delays in the Northeast.
